bus.via: Wellington Station - Platform 10 to Trentham Station

trips.route_note: Take a Hutt Valley Line (Tranz Metro) train from Wellington Station directly to Upper Hutt, roughly 45 minutes with no changes.
trips.tour_query: Kaitoke Regional Park day trip from Wellington
trips.why: The Hutt Valley Line train runs direct from Wellington Station in about 45 minutes with no changes, faster and simpler than the bus.
know: Trentham Station is the stop for the Trentham area, not Upper Hutt Station itself
Trains run frequently on the Hutt Valley Line, so no need to book ahead
A straightforward suburban trip rather than a classic sightseeing day out
